pages.text: $(#ffe48a)【Undying】$()$(br2)Glows, and grants Undying to allied mobs within 16 blocks: on death they come back as if holding a Totem of Undying, once each. Fades 5 s after leaving its range; it does not protect itself.$(br2)$(l)Accessory$(): Undying Golden Calyx, which wards this affix off.
$(l)Dropped material$()$(br2)$(o)A golden calyx-shaped crystal that grows back wherever it falls away.$()
